text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days after the fierce battle of the 
Classic Triple Crown's first leg, the 
Satsuki Sho, came to an end—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, there's some kind of press 
conference on TV.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Huh, what press conference? Wait, isn't 
that girl—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Isn't that Agnes Tachyon?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—That news sent shockwaves rippling 
through Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"As of today, I, Agnes Tachyon— shall be 
taking an 'indefinite hiatus' from 
racing!"

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Eeehhhhh...t?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—An Umamusume who was a leading figure on 
the Triple Crown route. Her sudden 
announcement... sent shockwaves through 
the venue.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Agnes Tachyon-san... When you showed such 
incredible potential even in the Satsuki 
Sho, why?!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Such praise, huh... Though I don't 
believe that was truly my best running 
yet."

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
She was considered a favorite for the 
Nippon Derby and the Kikuka Sho, so why on 
earth did this happen!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—The Satsuki Sho Umamusume of light 
speed. The Triple Crown path's leading 
star makes a sudden announcement... and 
the venue freezes in shock.”

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Agnes Tachyon-san... When you won the 
Satsuki Sho with such a magnificent run, 
why?!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Such praise, huh... Though I don't 
believe that was truly my best running 
yet."

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Even with the Double Crown and Triple 
Crown seen as virtually guaranteed, why on 
earth would she do that!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, there are various reasons. The truth 
is always multifaceted.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Is this... effectively a declaration of 
retirement...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
There's no point in asking me that. After 
all, no one can predict a certain future.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: —That concludes the presentation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, Agnes Tachyon vanished without 
a trace. But—I already knew where she was 
heading.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: What... do you mean by that, Tachyon-san?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I don't care what you do with your own 
life. However...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
And here I thought all I had to do was 
pursue them...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I have my own circumstances to consider. 
Besides—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Cafe, Trainer. This is a situation the 
two of you brought about."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. An alternative option, still fresh in 
our memory—it showed the potential of that 
choice.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If you ask whether there is only one path, 
that's not the case. Even if there is only 
one truth to prove, multiple paths might 
lead to it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Whether one quits or not is a trivial 
matter that misses the essence. Namely, 
'with what' and 'how' one reaches the 
destination."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: What... do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
To think you still don't understand after 
hearing all that. Hehehe, hahahahaha—!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"‘Advisor’! An ‘Advisor’! I shall become 
your advisor, Cafe!"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Eh... An advisor!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe raised her voice, something 
she rarely ever did.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...What's that look for? Something not to 
your liking?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It's not that I'm dissatisfied, so to 
speak... I just don't really understand...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In other words, it comes down to this: I 
acknowledge Cafe's talent and your support 
capabilities, Trainer, but it is not 
enough.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"My proposition is to add my scientific 
prowess into the mix. Crystal clear, is it 
not?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You can get closer to your "friend" much 
faster. That's simply what it comes down 
to.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: "Friend"... Do you believe in them too...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Believing or not believing is irrelevant. 
All that matters to me is achieving my 
objective.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
............ I suppose, deep down, I 
still...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Cafe doesn't seem to care for it, 
but Trainer, you don't mind it, do you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"A brilliant person like you surely sees 
the appeal of this proposal, don't you?"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... You're not... going to agree to 
that, are you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest, my feelings were swaying. 
If I could borrow Agnes Tachyon's 
intellect, it would be a huge help.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Besides, Cafe, your "friend" was aligned 
on the same vector as me, wasn't he?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Knowing how I intended to run moving 
forward would be the quickest shortcut to 
your goal, I imagine.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: U-Uuuu...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, a section of this room! I 
shall cede the very spot you and I fought 
over to you!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now you have room to display them, yes? 
Those bizarre dolls you cherish so much. 
It's like a victory parade.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Um... the place...! Oh, ooh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe desperately craved it. 
...The outcome was decided.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Then let's take a vote once more. All in 
favor of appointing me as advisor!? Yes, 
yes, yes!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heheheh... Good, this will do. Just like 
this.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "Plan B"—commence! Hahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In an unexpected twist, Agnes Tachyon 
joins in. Thus, Manhattan Cafe's Classic 
Road began heading in an unforeseen 
direction.
